{{Quote|Zaloriis formally declares its independence.|Transe Decar to Darth Vader|audio=ZaloriisIndependence-SWGB.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Zalorian''' was the name given to the inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]], covering the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population and creatures such as the [[Zalorian rock-lion|rock-lion]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the Humans led by [[Zalor Minister]] [[Transe Decar]] formed a [[Zalorian Separatists|movement]] to secede from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but the insurrection was [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|defeated]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Behind the scenes==
The in-game databank of ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' referred to the group as "'''Zaloriians'''", however in every other instance in the game and in subsequent sources the spelling "Zalorian" is used
